findings.title: Dark mode: PlatoMark icon hardcoded to colors.gray[700], invisible on dark backgrounds
findings.description: PlatoMark in Fit card header uses colors.gray[700] (#404040) directly. In dark mode this is near-invisible against dark card backgrounds. The analog in the same file (AchievementIcon line 723) correctly uses t.dark ? t.color.gray[400] : t.color.gray[700].
findings.fix: Import useTheme from @emotion/react, call at component top level, pass theme-aware color to PlatoMark. Remove unused colors import.

dismissed.title: Static possiblePaths with unconditional 'ai'
dismissed.reason: User-directed override from prior conversation. User explicitly said to use static possiblePaths and unconditional Route, matching AccountIntegrationsContainer pattern.

dismissed.title: match.url.replace() deviates from spec formula
dismissed.reason: Spec bug. match.url at the /overview route includes /overview, so spec formula match.url + '/ai' would produce /overview/ai (wrong). Implementation correctly strips last segment. Already documented as known non-issue in Layer 1.

downgraded_to_med.title: || 0 fabricated fallback for aiJobApplicationSummaryId
downgraded_to_med.reason: Hook enabled guard (!!id && id > 0) prevents any HTTP request when ID is 0. No runtime impact. Code smell per Known Failure Pattern #13 but not a bug. Cleaner fix would accept undefined but ripples to all callers of the hook.
